nodes.label: Silent Anonymous Auth Session
nodes.rationale: No sign-in screen: every visitor gets a silent anonymous Supabase Auth session automatically on first load, so no page ever needs to show a sign-in UI — reduces friction for family members joining via a shared link.

nodes.label: Double Authorization Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Ownership is checked both in Server Actions (against tree.owner_id) and again via Postgres RLS policies, so the UI hiding controls is never the only safeguard — defense in depth against a bypassed client.

nodes.label: Freeform Canvas Placement
nodes.rationale: persons.placed plus position_x/position_y let unconnected people be positioned freely on the canvas with grid snapping; the pedigree layout takes over once a person is connected.

nodes.label: Match-and-Claim Transaction
nodes.rationale: Matching a joiner to an existing placeholder or account runs as a single transactional Postgres RPC (claim_or_create_person) rather than client-side logic, so it must not be reimplemented client-side and avoids race conditions/inconsistent claims.

nodes.label: Security-Definer RPCs for Shared Reads
nodes.rationale: Shared-link pages must be readable by anonymous visitors, so those reads go through security-definer RPCs (get_tree_by_token, get_tree_data) instead of shipping a service-role key to the browser; only the anon key ships client-side.

nodes.label: Custom SVG Pedigree Canvas
nodes.rationale: No graph library is used; the pedigree is a hand-built SVG canvas with parent/child/spouse ports wired together by dragging, ComfyUI-style, giving full control over mobile-first pan/zoom/drag interactions.
